evidence: The papal Petitions (5) and Letters (2) and the Clarendon calendar (1) are William Henry Bliss's editorial work; the truncated Twemlow entry (1) likely is too, giving about 9/11 weighted citations. The social-reform encyclopedia (1) is William Dwight Porter Bliss's. The Irish Patent Rolls entry remains unresolved.

Por um inventário dos sentidos is Antonio Gilberto Ramos Nogueira's (6/12 weighted citations, approximately half). Both A raça negra entries (3 combined) are António Francisco Nogueira's, as confirmed by the Smithsonian catalogue. Vida de agricultor is catalogued as cordel by Antonio Nogueira; the military report and generic Análise Social entry cannot be assigned to the LC author.

Wang Dewei is David Der-wei Wang (王德威). The publisher credits him with both leading books and the Chinese Literature survey; Harvard also lists A New Literary History. The other listed publications belong to the same literary scholar, including his coedited collections and Post-Loyalism writing.

Adrien is the French form used by Adriano Balbi. His 1822 Portugal statistics, Variétés politico-statistiques, and 1826 ethnographic atlas and introduction account for all listed works. Google Books identifies Adriano as author of the Variétés and links the Portugal study and atlas introduction under him.

Hitler and Stalin, The Liberal Tradition with Maurice Shock, the Ernest Bevin biography, and the dictionary edited with Stephen Trombley are Alan Bullock's works. Allan is a spelling error. The Bevin entry runs into a separate Burns citation, but its identifiable Bullock title is correct.

Black Africans (7), the 2020 Portuguese journal contribution, the 2022 Nascimento tribute contribution, and the 2024 Rui de Pina edition are Thomas Foster Earle's: 10/12 weighted citations confirmed. For Cod and Country (1) is Thomas Blake Earle's, confirmed by SMU. The bare [1980] entry is unresolved.

Construtores de identidades and its shortened pedagogia da nação entry are Arlette Medeiros Gasparello's book. Her publication list also includes O Colégio Pedro II e as humanidades. Arlete/Arlette is a spelling variation; the latter work's supplied year differs from its documented 2002 conference appearance.

Xenophon is William Edward Higgins's, carrying 5/10 weighted citations, exactly half. Both Joseph Gould entries (3 combined) are W. H. Higgins's 1887 biography and its 1972 reprint. The bleaching treatise is the chemist William Higgins's. The 1931 banking letter predates the LC author's 1945 birth.
The sole listed work, The English Gentleman Merchant at Work (2005), is explicitly credited to Søren Mentz in the library catalogue. Soren simply omits the Danish diacritic.

other_people: Vinícius de Bragança Müller e Oliveira
evidence: De Manoel Congo (5), Sobre águas revoltas (2), the coauthored Lanceiros chapter (1), and the Santa Casa contribution (1) are Vinicius Pereira de Oliveira's: 9/10 weighted citations. Centralização e Descentralização (1) is the 2006 economics dissertation by Vinícius de Bragança Müller Oliveira, separately identified by USP's catalogue.
